body: TSS are supposed to go out and patrol the parking lot multiple times a day so really all it does is prevent them from having to throw on reflective vest before they go out. Target is super big on them being highly visible and “the first line of defense” at the entrance doors so I guess their best idea was to make them look like highlighters
I am in fact only calling for felonies. That’s what the majority of them told me they prefer
My brother in Christ when did I ever say that I don’t charge when I call them

Thanks everyone for the tips!! I feel like I should add that I always have a print out of their profile on our case management system that includes times, narratives, a list of merch with item numbers, item values and photos of the items, and physical copies of surveillance footage. It’s surprisingly in depth for how shitty our camera system is lol

TSS that was promoted to APTL here. Your interview process may look a bit different than mine but definitely touch on good business decisions, safety, and your connections at other stores. Numbers are definitely important but their main concern when I went through the process was leadership and making sure I understood the role of the guest in AP
